buttons.name: 清理旧版本 jar
buttons.command: powershell -NoProfile -Command "$v=(Select-String -Path gradle.properties -Pattern '^mod_version=(\S+)').Matches.Groups[1].Value; $cv=(Select-String -Path clientsmoke/gradle.properties -Pattern '^mod_version=(\S+)').Matches.Groups[1].Value; $t=Get-ChildItem versions,clientsmoke/versions -Recurse -Filter *.jar* | Where-Object { $_.DirectoryName -match 'build\\libs$' -and $_.Name -notmatch [regex]::Escape($v) -and $_.Name -notmatch [regex]::Escape($cv) }; $t | Remove-Item -Force; Write-Host ('deleted ' + $t.Count + ' old jars, kept ' + $v + ' / ' + $cv)"
